question: Which eternal presence should be satisfied after the visualization of Shiva?
premises: The act follows the prior visualization
The object is the eternal yuga-kalā
The root mantra is the instrument
inference: After visualization, the eternal yuga-kalā should be satisfied with the root mantra.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of yugakalā is not specified in this verse
plain_english: Then one should satisfy the eternal yuga-kalā with the root mantra.
